newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma ranges, depos, forwards, bonds unmoved.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma ranges, depos, forwards, bonds unmoved.

text.p: Ecu/drachma was trading narrowly holding above the 311 level, depos, forex forwards and bonds were holding mid-session levels in late dealings, traders said.
"Depos are frozen and forex forwards are resting after this morning's pick up," said a dealer at a foreign bank.
Bonds traders said the market was quiet and bond prices paralysed.
"The CPI-linked bond was the focus of the market earlier today as some players sought funding for it," a bond trader said.
Greece will issue five and 10-year, 4.0 percent CPI-indexed bonds on May 19.
The mark was quoted at 159.33/43 from Friday's 159.495 fix, the dollar at 271.08/18 drachmas from 271.300 and the ecu at 311.06/16 from 311.440 drachmas.
"Ecu/drachma is consolidating above 311 after a volatile session that took it from 311.65/75 to 310.85/95 and then firmed again to 311.10/20 in late dealings," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
Bank of Greece sold more than $100 million for drachmas at the fixing pushing ecu/drachma lower too.
